{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].values)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))

# Define the population: completed orders, excluding QA and refunded
population = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

print("Total population size:", len(population))

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = population.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by segment:", conversion_rates)

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
print("Best segment:", best_segment)"}
